body: Negative net worth (equity capital + reserves) is rare among Rs 200-20,000 cr Indian companies (1.4% weighted). 7 of 13 flagged rows failed (43% vs 19.7% base); excludes 2 of 92 >=3x winners. One in three S1 firms entered CIRP within 5 years (33.5% vs 3.6%). Examples caught: ABG Shipyard, GTL, Jet Airways, McNally Bharat, Indosolar. Payout exemption never applied. Not refuted - not enough cases.
title: India solvency back-test FY2016/18: S1 negative net worth -> QUESTION (lift 2.20, CI 0.50-4.42; only 13 flagged rows) - same size as US, underpowered
